Whiteboard and demo deep dive into the Azure Load Balancer! Hope you find it useful and have a drink handy :-D

Whiteboard - https://github.com/johnthebrit/RandomStuff/blob/master/Whiteboards/alb%20live.svg

Few links used:

- SKUs - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/load-balancer/skus
- Limits - Aka.ms/lblimits
- SNAT Ports - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/load-balancer/load-balancer-outbound-connections#snatporttable
